metadata.question: Did the surface water area of Poyang Lake in China’s Jiangxi Province decrease between July 10, 2022 and August 27, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Poyang Lake, Jiangxi Province, China (approximately 29.0°N, 116.2°E) - Dates: July 10, 2022 and August 27, 2022 (specific dates) - Collection: JRC Global Surface Water or Sentinel-1/2 for water detection - Best approach: Use Sentinel-2 with water indices (NDWI or MNDWI) or Sentinel-1 for water mapping 2. Masking strategy: - Need to identify water pixels for both dates - Use NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) or MNDWI (Modified NDWI) - Cloud masking is important for optical data - Calculate water area for each date 3. Logic to distinguish results: - Valid result: Both dates have images and valid water area calculations - C1: No images found for one or both dates - C2: Images exist but no valid pixels after processing - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - A: Water area decreased (2022-08-27 < 2022-07-10) - B: Water area did not decrease (2022-08-27 >= 2022-07-10) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const poyang = ee.Geometry.Point([116.2, 29.0]).buffer(30000); // 30km buffer around Poyang Lake const date1 = '2022-07-10'; const date2 = '2022-08-27'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(poyang) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); const col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(poyang) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`July 10 images: ${size1}`); console.log(`August 27 images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('Missing data for one or both dates'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate water area using MNDWI function addMNDWI(image) { const mndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('MNDWI'); return image.addBands(mndwi); } function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(cloudMask); } const img1 = col1.map(maskClouds).map(addMNDWI).median(); const img2 = col2.map(maskClouds).map(addMNDWI).median(); // Water threshold: MNDWI > 0 const water1 = img1.select('MNDWI').gt(0); const water2 = img2.select('MNDWI').gt(0); // 4. Calculate water area const area1Stats = water1.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: poyang, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const area2Stats = water2.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: poyang, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const pixelCount1 = water1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: poyang, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('MNDWI').getInfo(); const pixelCount2 = water2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: poyang, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('MNDWI').getInfo(); console.log(`July 10 pixel count: ${pixelCount1}`); console.log(`August 27 pixel count: ${pixelCount2}`); if (pixelCount1 === 0 || pixelCount2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing'); console.log('C2'); return; } const area1 = area1Stats.get('MNDWI').getInfo(); const area2 = area2Stats.get('MNDWI').getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (area1 === null || area2 === null || isNaN(area1) || isNaN(area2)) { console.log('Calculation failed'); console.log('C3'); return; } const area1_km2 = (area1 / 1e6).toFixed(2); const area2_km2 = (area2 / 1e6).toFixed(2); console.log(`July 10 water area: ${area1_km2} km2`); console.log(`August 27 water area: ${area2_km2} km2`); console.log(`Change: ${(area2 - area1) / 1e6} km2`); if (area2 < area1) { console.log('Water area decreased'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Water area did not decrease'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
